title: Dot Patterns
description: A generator of repeating geometric patterns built from little dashes, in the spirit of the dotted 'coated-canvas' weaves on designer luggage and endpapers. Pick a tiling — the Goyard-style chevron 'Y' weave whose dashed arrows cross into 6-pointed stars, a simpler chevron weave, a herringbone, a diamond trellis or a basket weave — set the scale, dash density, weight and palette, and it fills the frame with a seamless static motif; a soft emboss highlight and a faint canvas texture sell the woven feel, and the whole field can be rotated live. It's a pattern, not an animation, so it renders once and holds. Seven palettes plus Random.
